description: Hold a basket of tokens at target weights: sell what has run ahead into USDC and buy what has lagged whenever any leg drifts out of band.

LEGS.description: The basket: 2 to 15 tokens. Every WEIGHT is a percent and they must add up to 100 (within 0.5). Fewer, more, or a different sum and the duty does nothing until it is fixed.

SYMBOL.description: The ticker, without a leading $. Used for labels, and as the token reference only for a chain's own coin.

ADDRESS.description: The exact contract address (EVM) or mint (Solana). Left out only for ETH, BNB or SOL held as a chain's own coin.

CHAIN_ID.description: The chain the contract lives on: 1 Ethereum, 56 BNB, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 4663 Virtuals, 1151111081099710 Solana.

WEIGHT.description: This token's target share of the index, in percent of the whole basket.

SEED_USD.description: USD spent once, on the first fire, buying the whole basket at its target weights. 0 adopts whatever the owner already holds of these tokens instead, and buys nothing.

BAND_PCT.description: Percentage POINTS of drift tolerated before a rebalance: a 33% leg at 39% is 6 points out. Below this, the fire does nothing.

MIN_TRADE_USD.description: USD below which a leg's correction is skipped rather than traded. Floored at 2, the swap route's own minimum.

MAX_REBALANCE_USD.description: USD ceiling on what one rebalance sells. The buys are funded only by those sells, so this caps the whole correction.

status.queued: Buys wait on sells · next check {next}
